title: Recover merge-queue declaration drift safely
trigger: Merge preflight refuses because the lane declaration differs from live enforcement rules.
need: Compare the gate branch declaration with live rules. When it matches live, update the lane from the gate branch, re-verify and retry merge. Apply only when the gate declaration also differs from live, from an up-to-date checkout of that branch. An unreadable gate declaration or live rules names gate_declaration_unverified and requires restoring the read before retry; never apply a stale lane declaration.
